title: Game protocol version
summary: The initial client message when connecting to the Game Server.
description:
# ProtocolVersion

## Purpose

The client sends its game protocol revision. The server compares it with the supported revisions and accepts or rejects the connection.

## Known fields

| Field | Representation | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Revision | 32-bit integer | Client game revision |

The initial exchange precedes game encryption. The complete message layout and opcode remain to be established.
